latest_autonomous_wave.goal: Create one selected product-facing authority that serializes pitch/key against all coordinator-backed transport/practice DSP work without inventing Playback/click generations, while preserving AW16 continuous-control concurrency and AW18 interruption fail-closed semantics.
latest_autonomous_wave.rationale: AW22 could measure pitch but direct controller pitch remained a correctness bypass. Because controller pitch and coordinator tempo/click operations mutate the same transactional DSP state across awaits, an uncoordinated pitch could commit a stale candidate and overwrite newer tempo. Pitch itself is not a transport discontinuity, so fake Playback/click generation changes would be incorrect; a shared/exclusive product authority is the appropriate Lane-local solution.
